name: Hop Hop Hop Dance
tagline: Turn two photos into playful dance videos
description: Hop Hop Hop Dance is a browser-based AI video generator for the two-person hop hop hop trend. Upload two photos of consenting adults, choose a scene, and create a silent eight-second vertical clip with the point, three hops, squash and swap sequence. Download the MP4 and add audio within your social platform. The website also provides practical guides to the dance and filming the effect yourself. It advertises one free guest clip per device, followed by optional one-time credit packs. Personal use only unless separately agreed in writing. Generated clips must be labelled as AI-generated.
